fix.delta: sov6-logic-v3-light returns 33/33 unparsed on DetBench — format/transport failure, not a true zero. The model outputs parseable JSON on every other axis except det and swarm. Root cause: DetBench questions use a different JSON schema (verdict object vs. score object) and the sov6-light template is not detecting the schema switch. Fix: add a schema-detect preamble that checks the expected output shape before generation. Not a model-capability gap — a transport-format mismatch.
